And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Rakesh Dwivedi

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
No one appears for the informant despite notice.
2. The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.03 of 2024 under sections 376, 506 IPC and section 3/4 POCSO Act, P.S. Maharua, District Ambedkar Nagar.

3. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant went missing from Pradeep Kumar Sharma @ Pradeep Sharma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. ... on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130214843/
1 28.12.2023 and was enticed away by the applicant.

entities.text: Pradeep Kumar Sharma @ Pradeep Sharma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Subsequently, in the statements under sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., the victim stated that physical relations were formed on the false pretext of marriage.

4. In the light of the said assertions, the counsel for the applicant draws my attention to the medical report on record which does not indicate the forming of any physical relations as even the hymen was found to be intact.

5. Considering the tentative age of the victim to be around 16 years coupled with the fact that the medical does not support the statement under sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., a case for bail is made out particularly when the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 07.01.2024.
Thus the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Pradeep Kumar Sharma @ Pradeep Sharma be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- (Twenty Thousand) each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 14.3.2024 VNP/-
